'''Fort Tonvarr''', also known as '''Fray Landing Base''' was a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] base located on the southern end of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum's]] [[Western Ice Shelf]].<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
During the [[Battle of Ilum]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Imperial forces overran Fray Landing and decimated the Republic forces stationed there. When the base was retaken, [[Fray Landing Memorial]] was established to commemorate the lost, and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] used the story of the base's last stand to press for the largest increase in military spending since the [[Treaty of Coruscant]].<ref name="TOR:FLM" />

Sometime that [[3640 BBY|same year]],<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|The Fall of Fort Tonvarr|Ilum}}</ref> the base was taken over by the [[Tonvarr pirates]]<ref name="Fall" /> when they sought to further expand their territorial control and lay claim the Western Ice Shelf.<ref name="Road">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Road to Fort Tonvarr|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref>
